title: Quality of Life in Thai Women Diagnosed Cervical Cancer at King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
brief_summary: To study the quality of life of patients earlier diagnosed for cervical cancer and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Thai patients
* aged more than 15 years old.
* Diagnosed of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) or cervical cancer with pathological confirmation. If she has more than one diseases, the most severe will be considered as diagnosis.
* Not suffered from confusion or reduced level of consciousness or unable to communicate.

Exclusion Criteria:
study_population: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) or cervical cancer patients
